status: Empty by design. No authorised first-party report has been supplied, so the ledger has zero rows and no totals.
rule: A row may be added only from an authorised first-party report — an Associates export the owner supplies, or a report from a platform the owner controls — and each row must record where it came from. A site click is not an order. Nothing here may be estimated, modelled, scraped or back-filled.

columns.name: period_start
columns.meaning: First day of the reporting window, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: period_end
columns.meaning: Last day of the reporting window, inclusive.

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: The report this row came from, named exactly as the system names it, e.g. 'Amazon Associates — Link Type report'.

columns.name: channel
columns.meaning: Where the traffic came from: organic search, direct, RSS, a named social post, an email send.

columns.name: eligible_sessions
columns.meaning: Sessions the report counts as eligible for attribution, as the report defines it. Never derived by subtraction from another column.

columns.name: clicks
columns.meaning: Outbound clicks the report attributes to this site and this window.

columns.name: reported_orders
columns.meaning: Orders the report attributes to this site and this window. Orders, not revenue, and only from the first-party report.

columns.name: provenance
columns.meaning: Path or reference to the underlying export, its export date, and who exported it.

columns.name: notes
columns.meaning: Anything that qualifies the row: a tracking gap, a currency or marketplace caveat, a known duplicate.

prohibited: Revenue or commission estimates of any kind.
Conversion rates calculated from modelled traffic.
Numbers copied from a screenshot without the underlying export.
Rows assembled from two reports with different windows.
